question_stem: An analogue signal is to be transmitted as a digital signal.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State two advantages of the transmission of data in digital form rather than in analogue form.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
The analogue signal is converted into a 4-bit digital signal. The digital signal is transmitted and then converted back into an analogue signal by a digital-to-analogue converter (DAC).
On Fig. 5.1, sketch the signal produced by the DAC for time $t = 0$ to $t = 14\text{ ms}$.

{{figure:figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1
parts.text: Sketch the signal produced by the DAC.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.part_stem: State the effect on the reconstructed signal of

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: increasing the number of bits in each digital number.
